findings.title: Closeout leaves generic preparation aliases and next-action pointers stale
findings.detail: The input current-run has preparation_review_path pointing to e02-source13-real-controlled-preparation, preparation_tests_passed=998, preparation_sync.local_tag=ultimaagent-t2-e03-source13-negative-prep-20261106, next_action prescribing an old metadata recovery, and next_offline_plan pointing to that old plan. closeout updates preparation_review_receipt/test_count/next_work and active_preparation but neither updates nor archives these unqualified aliases. Executing the reviewed script therefore leaves contradictory current preparation pointers/counts and next actions. This is a static defect in the pending closeout, not a demand that publication already be executed.
